name: Handstand pushup
description: A handstand pushup is a pushup while doing a handstand. Hold a handstand, lower the head toward the floor between the hands, then press back up.

items.content: Body inverted and in one straight line
Hands about shoulder width apart, fingers spread
Core braced, glutes squeezed, ribs in
Shoulders active, pushing tall through the hands
Neck neutral, gaze between the hands

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Head to the floor between the hands, elbows bent, body inverted and straight.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Elbows locked in a handstand, body inverted and straight.
